evidence.evidence_text: Method: We propose an Etiology-Aware Attention Supervision framework that introduces structured etiological information as an external supervisory signal for training large language models.

However, their trustworthiness in diagnosis-oriented medical tasks remains constrained by the lack of structured guidance on how clinically relevant diagnostic evidence is internally attended to and utilized during model learning.
